name: Gemini Cookie Sync
description: Exports Gemini cookies plus XSRF/build metadata for gemini-web2api. v1.15: image-bridge results report the extension version so the server/watchdog can flag a stale (unreloaded) build. v1.14: image bridge timing - waits the full server budget (real cycle: poll + cold window load + answer can take minutes) and self-diagnoses when no answer appears. v1.13: image bridge robustness - the page posts results directly (survives service-worker suspension). v1.12: image bridge - processes image requests in a real Gemini window (BardErrorInfo 1100 workaround). v1.11: bolder icon. v1.10: toolbar cookie-age badge. v1.9: desktop stale/405 notifications. v1.8: one-tap Refresh in the health panel. v1.7: live Server health panel.
